notes.subject: אֲנָקָה · לְטָאָה · חֹמֶט
notes.rationale: three of the five creature names in this verse occur only here; all identifications are zoological inferences, not certainties.

notes.subject: כֹּחַ
notes.rationale: the word is the common noun for 'strength/power'; here, uniquely, it names the monitor lizard — a homograph lost in English.

notes.subject: תִּנְשֶׁמֶת
notes.rationale: the same name names a bird in Lev 11:18 and this lizard here; 'chameleon' here follows the SDBH sense.

notes.subject: the catalogue
notes.rationale: the verse continues the species list begun in v. 29 with no verb of its own.

translation: and the gecko, and the monitor-lizard, and the wall-lizard, and the skink, and the chameleon.
